en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 6.Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Abū Ayyūb, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) who said, “

Whoever does an evil deed is given a respite of seven hours of the day. If he says, ‘I seek repentance from Allah, besides Whom there is no god, [He is] the Living, the Eternal’ three times, it (the sin) will not be recorded for him.”
